home.trends.definition: Comparison cohort: current {current}, previous {previous}; {included} included projects and {excluded} excluded
home.trends.inspectHint: Open Comparison details for values, cohort and capture times
home.trends.basis: Latest snapshot per project at or before {target} ({days} days before today). Due-window figures use {window} days from each side's own date. On Track changes are percentage points.
home.trends.exclusions: Excluded projects are omitted from both sides when the capture, access basis, window, time zone or status filter cannot match. Card figures may cover more projects than the comparison cohort. Team Members has no trend.
home.trends.filteredScope: Historical snapshots do not reproduce this discipline or people filter, so no whole-project trend is substituted
home.preset.label: Scope preset
home.preset.additionalFilter: This role filter also applies to the selected projects
home.preset.disciplineHint: Tasks, deliverables and deadlines are limited to the disciplines you lead. Milestones without a led discipline are excluded.
home.preset.supervisorHint: Tasks, deliverables and deadlines are limited to your current people scope. Milestones have no recorded person owner and are excluded.
home.preset.notSaved: The current scope is applied, but the preset preference was not saved
